name: Maharashtra
description: The land of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, dynamic coastline, Sahyadri mountain forts, and ancient UNESCO rock-cut wonders of Ajanta and Ellora.
heritage: Ajanta & Ellora Caves, Gateway of India, Raigad Fort, Elephanta Caves
art: Warli Tribal Painting, Paithani Silk Weaving
festivals: Ganesh Chaturthi, Gudi Padwa, Banganga Festival
cuisine: Puran Poli, Misal Pav, Modak, Vada Pav

name: Rajasthan
description: The Land of Kings, legendary palaces, golden desert dunes, vibrant folk dances, and grand fortified citadels echoing royal valor.
heritage: Amer Fort, Hawa Mahal, Mehrangarh Fort, City Palace
art: Jaipur Blue Pottery, Bandhani Textiles, Miniature Painting
festivals: Pushkar Camel Fair, Teej, Desert Festival, Gangaur
cuisine: Dal Baati Churma, Gatte ki Sabzi, Ker Sangri, Ghevar

name: Punjab
description: The Land of Five Rivers, known for its warm hospitality, golden wheat fields, divine Golden Temple, and high-energy Bhangra beats.
heritage: Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib), Jallianwala Bagh, Wagah Border
art: Phulkari Embroidery, Punjabi Jutti Crafts, Wood Carving
cuisine: Makki di Roti & Sarson da Saag, Butter Chicken, Lassi, Amritsari Kulcha

name: Uttarakhand
description: The Devbhumi (Land of the Gods), nestled in the serene Himalayas with sacred rivers, revered pilgrimage routes, and pristine alpine valleys.
heritage: Badrinath & Kedarnath Temples, Valley of Flowers, Rishikesh Ghats
art: Aipan Ritual Art, Ringal Bamboo Craft, Wood Inlay
festivals: Kumbh Mela, Ganga Dussehra, Phool Dei, Harela

name: Jharkhand
description: The Land of Forests, blessed with cascading waterfalls, rich tribal traditions, sacred hills, and ancient indigenous folklore.
heritage: Baidyanath Dham, Parasnath Hills, Hundru Falls, Maluti Temples
art: Sohrai & Khovar Murals, Dokra Metal Casting, Bamboo Crafts
festivals: Sarhul, Karam Festival, Tusu Parab, Jawa Festival
